notes: Props are no longer placed automatically inside the image 2 templates.

There is now a standalone prop library in the Elements tool with three groups and 24 realistic transparent props: plants, mugs, trays, books, towels, baskets, risers, linen, plates, glass, candles, frames, pebbles, ornaments, vases, perfume, lipstick, brushes, soap, oil bottles, lemons, coffee beans, wooden spoons and spice jars.
Place any prop yourself, then drag, scale and rotate it like any other element.
